Name: Haskell
Description: Haskell grammar for the Minotaur parser platform: Haskell 2010 core plus MultiWayIf/LambdaCase (modules, imports with as/hiding, data/type/newtype with deriving, class/instance, guards, do/case/let, list comprehensions, sections). Full lexing surface engine-verified via Conformance.txt (symop operator class, primes, hex/octal, {- -} and -- comments, pragmas).
